mapper.select: SELECT ss.id, ss.employee_id, ss.base_salary, ss.meal_allowance, e.bank_name as bankName, e.account_number_enc as accountNumberEnc, e.employee_name as accountHolder, ss.apply_start_date, ss.apply_end_date FROM salary_setting ss JOIN employee e ON ss.employee_id = e.employee_id WHERE ss.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND ss.apply_start_date <= #{targetDate} AND (ss.apply_end_date IS NULL OR ss.apply_end_date >= #{targetDate}) ORDER BY ss.apply_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT insurance_id, apply_year, national_pension_rate, health_insurance_rate, long_term_care_rate, emp_insurance_rate FROM insurance_rate WHERE apply_year = #{applyYear}

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount, employee_name_snapshot as employeeNameSnapshot, dept_name_snapshot as deptNameSnapshot, position_name_snapshot as positionNameSnapshot FROM payroll_ledger WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY year_month DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount, employee_name_snapshot as employeeNameSnapshot, dept_name_snapshot as deptNameSnapshot, position_name_snapshot as positionNameSnapshot FROM payroll_ledger WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND year_month LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') ORDER BY year_month DESC

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount, employee_name_snapshot as employeeNameSnapshot, dept_name_snapshot as deptNameSnapshot, position_name_snapshot as positionNameSnapshot FROM payroll_ledger WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount, employee_name_snapshot as employeeNameSnapshot, dept_name_snapshot as deptNameSnapshot, position_name_snapshot as positionNameSnapshot FROM payroll_ledger WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND year_month = #{yearMonth}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_ledger ( employee_id, insurance_id, year_month, salary_amount, overtime_amount, meal_amount, total_payment, net_pay, is_finalized, is_sent, national_pension_amount, health_insurance_amount, long_term_care_amount, emp_insurance_amount, income_tax_amount, local_tax_amount, employee_name_snapshot, dept_name_snapshot, position_name_snapshot ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{insuranceId}, #{yearMonth}, #{salaryAmount}, #{overtimeAmount}, #{mealAmount}, #{totalPayment}, #{netPay}, #{isFinalized}, #{isSent}, #{nationalPensionAmount}, #{healthInsuranceAmount}, #{longTermCareAmount}, #{empInsuranceAmount}, #{incomeTaxAmount}, #{localTaxAmount}, #{employeeNameSnapshot}, #{deptNameSnapshot}, #{positionNameSnapshot} )
mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_name as employeeName, o.org_name as departmentName, p.position_name as positionName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON h.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON h.position_id = p.position_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}
